response.sql: SELECT SUM(state_totals.total_invoice_amount) AS sum_of_state_totals, AVG(state_totals.invoice_count) AS average_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS total_invoice_amount, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) AS state_totals;
